ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; approximately 88% high-intensity white pixels to 12% low-intensity black pixels localized at the margins and focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity black banding along the entire trailing edge and lateral margins. Discrete dark focal spots are distributed across the white surface: a cluster of roughly circular spots in the upper left quadrant of the left lobe, and isolated spots in the central-right regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a sharp interior angle; apex depth is approximately 18% of the visible vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations ranging between 5 and 20 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the superior margin of both lobes, transitioning into jagged, irregularly shaped lateral tips that sweep downward.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of roughly circular dark-pixel rings and solid spots; specifically, a dense constellation on the outer left lobe and individual rings scattered across the central white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensively jagged trailing edge with irregular, fine-scale tissue loss; prominent dark pigmentation or scar patch on the distal right lobe margin.
